ideas.idea: Render Blog posts in a Server Component and give each post its own page/URL
ideas.why: The blog fetches in useEffect and articles are bare titles, so the posts and any per-post links are missing from server HTML.

ideas.idea: Add canonicals to Docs and Blog
ideas.why: The code shows no canonical on either page, and metadataBase is set, so a relative canonical resolves to an absolute URL.
This is accurate because no JSON-LD exists, but it's standard advice with little proven effect for a small site.

ideas.idea: Flesh out Docs with the actual setup steps as text
ideas.why: The Docs page has a single sentence even though its description promises setup help.

ideas.idea: List plans and prices on Pricing and consider Product/Offer structured data
ideas.why: Pricing has one sentence while its description says plans for every team size, so adding the plans and prices fills a real content gap.

ideas.idea: Expand the home page copy and link onward to Pricing and Docs from the body
ideas.why: The home page is thin, but this advice would fit almost any site, and the nav already links those pages.

ideas.idea: Make Docs and Pricing titles more descriptive with the brand name
ideas.why: The titles are just 'Docs' and 'Pricing', which carry no brand context in results.

ideas.idea: Add <lastmod> to the sitemap or generate it with app/sitemap.ts
ideas.why: The sitemap has no lastmod, but adding it is optional and has little effect on a four-URL site.

ideas.idea: Add a viewport tag (the item actually describes adding openGraph social tags)
ideas.why: Open Graph tags are accurate for any site, but the item is mislabeled as a viewport tag, and Next adds a default viewport anyway.
